evidence_basis: Published source theory. Source auditing and comparisons are not independent recalculation or experimental validation.

prior.summary: New to the reviewed candidate mechanism catalogue, source prediction already published; not first discovery.
prior.case_context: The exact formula query did not identify an experimental exact ordered metal phase. ROOT primary lookup found HEA/carbide studies of TiNbMoTa; those are composition references with different disorder/interstitial chemistry, not this source four-site ordered metal geometry. Source 2023 prediction is already known.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Both Ta→Nb and W→Mo frozen routes are favorable, whereas replacement of Nb by Ta in TiNb2Mo is adverse. All are geometry-selected controls, not selected by Tc. No high-W/high-n claim; exact SG216 role/composition construction has direct scalar EPC support. Real HEA disorder/carbon or nitrogen contamination are distinct possible physical states, not parent properties.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure -0.001 GPa; fine force 0.0 eV/Å, pressure -0.079 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

counterevidence.scope: This frozen alternative has both higher coupling and higher source-model Tc than the target; the selected-control advantage does not extend to every alternative.

unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Ta-to-Nb ordered role substitution in Ti-Mo-Ta quaternary framework. coupled chemical/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Resolve source site-orbital and mode response for Ta/Nb on this ordered metal structure. Favorable: matched ordering retains direct EPC/Tc advantage; adverse: observed real state is disordered/carbidic or response reverses; ambiguous: same formula without phase coordinates.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
